latex-workshop.latex.tools.name: paper-build
args: paper_search_dir=$(dirname -- "$1"); while [ ! -f "$paper_search_dir/build-paper.sh" ]; do if [ "$paper_search_dir" = / ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Cannot find build-paper.sh above the selected document.' >&2; exit 2; fi; paper_search_dir=$(dirname -- "$paper_search_dir"); done; exec bash "$paper_search_dir/build-paper.sh" "$1" "$2"
